newsitem.title: UK: UK shares open higher as gilts advance.
newsitem.headline: UK shares open higher as gilts advance.

text.p: UK stocks nudged higher in early trading on Monday, bolstered by a steady close on Wall Street on Friday and a strong showing by gilts rose following the European Union's weekend stability pact.
The FTSE 100 was up 11.4 points at 3,983.8 by 0847 GMT, with rising stocks in a nine-to-two majority, and some traders said the UK market might yet experience its traditional year-end rally.
British Aerospace lost a modest early gain after news of the merger agreement between Boeing Co and McDonnell Douglas. By 0855 GMT it was down 10-1/2p at 1,115p.
